additions.reasoning: The specification does not mention storing pets as an array within pet-type documents. It treats pets and pet-types as separate resources with their own endpoints.

additions.description: Uses 'slogan', 'color', 'skin_type', 'top_speed', 'diet', 'main_prey' fields from Ninja API for attributes
additions.reasoning: The specification only mentions using 'temperament' or 'group_behavior' fields from Ninja API for attributes, not these additional fields.

additions.description: Default lifespan value of 0 when not provided by Ninja API
additions.reasoning: The specification states lifespan should be null when not provided by Ninja API, not default to 0.

omissions.description: Does not implement birthdate filtering (birthdateGT/birthdateLT) for GET /pet-types/{id}/pets
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires supporting birthdateGT and birthdateLT query parameters for filtering pets by birthdate, but the code doesn't implement this.

omissions.description: Does not check if pet-type has pets before allowing deletion (DELETE /pet-types/{id})
omissions.reasoning: The specification states a pet-type can only be deleted if there are no pets of that type, but the code doesn't check this condition.

omissions.description: Does not return 400 when trying to delete a pet-type that has pets
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires returning 400 when attempting to delete a pet-type that has pets, but the code doesn't implement this check.

omissions.description: Does not properly handle PUT /pet-types/{id}/pets/{name} to update only provided fields
omissions.reasoning: The specification states PUT should update only the fields provided in the payload, but the code requires the name field to be included and updates all fields.

omissions.description: Does not properly validate picture-url content type as .jpg or .png
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires validating that picture-url contains a .jpg or .png image, but the code only checks if the URL is reachable.

omissions.description: Does not return 'NA' for missing lifespan when Ninja API doesn't provide it
omissions.reasoning: The specification states lifespan should be null when not provided by Ninja API, but the code defaults to 0.

omissions.description: Does not properly split attributes from Ninja API on whitespace (keeps comma-separated values as single attributes)
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires splitting attributes on whitespace to create an array, but the code splits on commas first, creating incorrect attribute arrays.
